summary.intent: Complete Phase 20 (Vault Migration) gap closure by planning and executing removal of dead migration code, then address CodeRabbit PR review comments on the resulting changes.
summary.outcome: Phase 20 fully completed with 6/6 plans executed, 9/9 verification truths passed, and 3 of 6 CodeRabbit review comments resolved with code fixes (fetch timeouts, XSS sanitization, zero-length key validation); 3 comments marked not applicable due to referencing already-removed code.

repo: Phase 20 is 'Vault Migration' — server now stores zero crypto material; rootFolderKey lives exclusively in IPFS v2 blobs
DB columns dropped: encrypted_root_folder_key, encrypted_root_ipns_private_key, migrated_at from vaults table
New user init now publishes v2 blob to IPFS before API registration (requires live env to verify)
Recovery tool uses IPFS-direct path; export-file format now only requires encryptedRootFolderKey (encryptedRootIpnsPrivateKey is optional/absent)
API client was regenerated after DTO simplification — downstream clients see simplified types with only ownerPublicKey + rootIpnsName
Prior phase regression suite: 5 test suites, 143 tests — all pass after Phase 20 changes
GSD plan commit was handled by the planner agent (bd236c59a), not the orchestrator — orchestrator should check before attempting duplicate commit

code.finding: Zero-length key_len must be rejected — added validation guard per CodeRabbit thread 6
All fetch() calls in IPNS resolution and IPFS fetch functions wrapped with fetchWithTimeout() helper to prevent hangs
rootIpnsName flows into innerHTML — added format validation against ^k[0-9a-z]{20,}$ and escapeHtml helper for exportedAt/derivationInfo
encryptedRootIpnsPrivateKey decryption made optional/tolerant of absence since export-file validation no longer requires it
Supersedes AddVaultMigratedAt migration — CodeRabbit comment on the older migration was not applicable
Migrate endpoint fully removed by gap closure — CodeRabbit comment referencing it was not applicable

workflow: GSD gap closure mode skips research and reads VERIFICATION.md directly — use --gaps-only flag on execute-phase to run only gap_closure plans
Pre-wave dependency check looks for key-links in plan frontmatter; if links are only in plan body they are not checked
Planner agent commits plans autonomously — orchestrator should verify before attempting its own commit to avoid duplicate commit errors
CodeRabbit review threads on plan files (.planning/*.md) are not applicable once plans have been executed
fetchWithTimeout pattern needed for recovery.html standalone tool — no framework timeout mechanism available in plain HTML/JS

friction: Verifier created VERIFICATION.md in a different working directory than expected, requiring multiple bash commands to locate the file
Orchestrator attempted to commit plans that were already committed by the planner agent, requiring extra git log checks
Pre-wave dependency check only catches key-links in plan frontmatter — links in plan body are silently skipped with no warning
open_items: 2 items need human verification in live environment: (1) new user init publishes v2 blob to IPFS before API registration, (2) recovery tool IPFS-direct path with real vault and live IPFS gateway
Next phase to plan/execute is Phase 23 (discuss-phase 23 suggested)
CodeRabbit reviewed plan files (.planning/*.md) which are not meaningful targets — consider adding .planning/ to PR review ignore patterns
